subject: Matt Leming Reelection Campaign
overview: City Councilor Matt Leming announced his campaign for a second term on the Medford City Council.

items.title: Reelection Campaign Announcement
items.summary: Councilor Matt Leming announced his candidacy for a second term on the City Council, highlighted achievements in housing, school funding, and immigrant rights, and invited the community to his campaign kickoff on June 14th.
